dedupe_keys.name: open database of recreational and sport facilities odrsf statistics canada

description: The ODRSF is a harmonised list of the names, types and locations of about 182,000 recreational and sport facilities across Canada, compiled by Statistics Canada from 452 open or directly provided datasets of provincial, territorial and municipal governments and professional organisations. Because the sources use different classifications, each facility is given one of eighteen types, among them trails, sports fields, arenas, athletic parks, beaches, community centres, gyms, marinas, parks, playgrounds, pools and skating rinks, and each is geocoded to a census subdivision. It is part of the Linkable Open Data Environment, which releases datasets under one licence with code to link them. Coverage: Canada, where source data exist. Access: free zipped CSV from Statistics Canada with a sources table and a metadata document. Licence: Open Government Licence - Canada. Caveats: version 1.0 from 2021 with no later version seen; coverage depends on which municipalities publish data, so gaps are uneven. Simulation uses are public space and community facility inventories for heat refuge, shelter and evacuation planning, and exposure counts of recreational assets. Related records: the Statistics Canada open databases of buildings and educational facilities and OpenStreetMap park features.
